G01.note: Champions free trade but wants tariffs on competitors: devotion is selective.

G02.note: Never departed from first principles: consistent; concise is the digression-contrast trap.

G03.note: Held in 2 of 7 regions, possibly weather: tenuous.

G04.note: Narrow ruling leaving the rest to the council: restrained.

G05.note: Precedent at every turn vs identical crimes getting wildly different sentences: scrupulous ... erratic.

G06.note: Dismissal overturned by a strict rule behind the angles: capricious (arbitrary); extravagant is not refuted by a rule.

G07.note: Wording lets both sides claim nothing surrendered, not a genuine settlement: cosmetic.

G09.note: Tempo carried in his head rather than on the page: markings were cursory; idiosyncratic weakly tempting but does not explain the clue.

G10.note: Seemingly random strings were a forty-year record: disjointed ... systematic.

G11.note: Floodlights drown the glow, darkness reveals it: drab ... luminous.

G12.note: Loyalty vanished on price rise plus rival: conditional; habitual is a weak tempter.

G13.note: Promise to end jams then forty homes demolished: appealing ... indignant.

G14.note: Each clash placed where meaning turns: arbitrary ... deliberate.

G15.note: Seldom more than a sentence vs sharp constant commands: taciturn ... assertiveness.

G16.note: Veteran, slow starts read as decline, refuted by faster finishes: deterioration.

G17.note: Recounting the same crabs inflates numbers: robust.

G18.note: Delayed supplies and quarrels over shares: meager ... cordial.

G19.note: Friends braced for disaster, then finest writing of the decade: scathing ... admiration.

G20.note: Small settings but wide emotional range, 'anything but': insular; florid is excluded by spare prose.

G21.note: Sounds insulting but means letting music breathe, not rushing: languid.

G22.note: Invisible repairs now opposed by visible-repair conservators: seamlessly ... contentious.

G23.note: Each side quoted it as support: equivocal.

G24.note: Pencil grids planned each drip: haphazard refuted.

G25.note: Expected to protect friend, instead candor: evasive.

G26.note: Accountants concede it paid off decades later: shrewd.

G27.note: Casual delivery mistaken for not caring, but each remark purposeful: indifference.

G28.note: So faint that many never found it: inconspicuous; disappointing contrasts with dazzling but does not cause not finding it.

G29.note: Crowded with subplots vs editors rarely changing a word: sprawling ... impeccable.

G30.note: Repeated until matched; 'as if inventing on the spot': exhaustive ... spontaneous.

G31.note: Jokes in public vs misplaced-decimal scrutiny: genial ... fastidious.

G32.note: Dreaded comments, students learned to check every claim: unsparing ... scrupulous.

G33.note: Drought shrinks once-generous allowances: stringent; provisional is tempted by the 'until autumn' clause but 'though' sets it in contrast.

G34.note: Stopped forty times for one phrase, without raising his voice: unrelenting.

G35.note: Supermajorities make change hard so the Constitution stays intact.

G36.note: Borrowing from teachers vs unmistakably her own: imitative ... distinctive.

G37.note: Far from everything, then pricing out artists: remote ... exorbitant.

G38.note: No predators, never needed to flee: unwary.
